work.title: Pelléas et Mélisande
work.movement: Act III, scene 1 · Mes longs cheveux descendent

version.value: Act III scene 1 excerpt for soprano and piano, with largely unaccompanied vocal phrases
version.note: The performing forces are established. The precise edition, any session-specific alteration and the original sounding pitch are not established. The two-record Garden 1904 set is an archival grouping, not a claim that these extracts form a two-movement composition.

performers.note: Both performers are named by the archive, national-library catalogue and specialist discography; no unnamed collaborator is supplied.

date.note: Only the year is established here; no exact day is inferred from a later reissue or modern repository date.

place.note: The city is documented. The studio, street address and recording engineer are not established.

label.note: Original commercial acoustic disc attribution. The 1937 IRCC/RCA carrier catalogued by BnF is a later reissue.

catalogue.note: Original G&T catalogue number. The archive describes a ten-inch disc.

matrixTakeSides.note: The common base number is 3078F. The archive suffix is preserved verbatim; it is not decoded as a verified take. The later IRCC transfer matrix 0EA5669-1 is not the original recording matrix.

credits.note: The archive names an uploader account but does not identify a transfer engineer. Uploader identity is not converted into a recording or mastering credit.

date.note: The 2019 added/public dates belong to the repository. No date of digitisation of this copy is established.

processing.value: Playback at 74 rpm; stylus-size field “35”; MP3 access file.
processing.note: The source supplies no units for the stylus-size string. Equalisation, noise reduction, pitch correction and equipment are not established. The speed is not treated as proof of the original session’s tuning or tempo.

digital.format: MP3 transfer of a ten-inch acoustic disc

composition.value: Underlying composition and original French words are out of copyright under ordinary life-plus-70 terms; the historical score predates 1926.
composition.note: Debussy died in 1918 and Maeterlinck in 1949. No modern translation is reproduced; national exceptions and modern editions require separate consideration.

recording.value: Rule 2 — US public domain: original G&T commercial issue dated 1904, before the 1925 cutoff.
recording.note: The original G&T catalogue and 1904 attribution establish a pre-cutoff recording publication basis. The 1937 reissue and 2019 archive upload are not used as the original publication date. No free-recording licence is inferred from a composition-only tag.

rights.creditLine: Claude Debussy, Mes longs cheveux descendent; Mary Garden, soprano, and Claude Debussy, piano. Paris, 1904; G&T 33447; Internet Archive transfer. US pre-1926 publication basis.

sources.title: Internet Archive — Mes longs cheveux
sources.locator: G&T catalogue 33447; date 1904; coverage Paris; Mary Garden and Debussy; soprano/piano; ten-inch disc; transfer at 74 rpm; stylus string 35 without stated units. The 2019 repository dates are not session or transfer dates.
